Sandy is visited by her three nieces, but SpongeBob gets in over his head when he volunteers to babysit.

LAD has a sleepover and in an effort to join in, Jack ends up making a promise that turns their night upside down. When Will's parents visit Canyon Valley, news of the sale of their bee farm sends the family into a big, honeying.

Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house. They must hide his awful habits from their parents. Seeking closure on her favourite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.
After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's ready for the adult world; Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.
A consultant becomes Boss Baby's worst nightmare after arriving at Baby Corp with zany ideas and setting his sights on the CEO's job.
Max and Phoebe discover that Lazlo Chance may be the evil mastermind and enlist Chloe to help. But when Chloe is torn between her head and her heart, it threatens the entire mission.

Paper takes the cellphones of Rock and Scissors, so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever. Rock cannot sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he is hard to please.
When SpongeBob cleans up the Boating School's lighthouse, he meets a cute but uncomfortable companion; no one is safe from a case of contagious hiccups.

Plankton needs help stealing the formula, so he hires an intern who knows more about Mr. Krabs than anyone. Patrick goes into a destructive fit whenever he hears a bell, so his friends help him in their own ways.
Taylor and the boys find a text in an old mobile phone that leads them to an infamous island.
Anika and Sal realise they've been tricked. Oliver must hide in plain sight at the Hunter House while Jasmyn is forced to cover for him at home, causing chaos all round.
Jasmyn makes a discovery in the forest, but can't figure out how it connects to the treasure hunt. Jake is finally coming home from the hospital, but there's a big surprise.
Frobisher Smythe's final trick is revealed. Rufus is circling closer, as is Victor! It's a race against time for find the true mask.
Senkhara is close to getting what she has longed for - and Nina will pay the ultimate price. Help comes from an unexpected source.
Fabian is devastated that Nina isn't coming back to Anubis, and Eddie is shocked when he recognises new girl, KT. He knows she's here on a secret quest. A new teacher moves in.
When a report comes out that declares Kid Danger's superpower an illness, Kid Danger has to convince Swellview that it is a huge misunderstanding.
When Drex escapes into the Time Jerker's time portal, Henry and Ray must go back into the past and stop him before he permanently alters Ray's past.
After being humiliated by Mike Cavalieri and the "Goldbladder" nickname for the millionth time, Lydia decides that enough is enough.
Taylor and the gang enter into an alternate universe where Uncle Charlie still lives on Rock Island.
A tremor hits Rock Island, which manages to open up a gateway to Atlantis. Later, Ellis ends up getting asked out on a date.
A new foster couple temporarily takes in Anika and Sal while Max and Tess uncover news about the blue diamond.
The kids begin to unravel the mystery around the missing red diamond, Max keeps a secret from his siblings.

SpongeBob helps out the Krusty Krab's night shift crew, but the customers crave something creepier than usual. When a gang of kids steals the Krusty Krab's grill, SpongeBob and Mr Krabs go to extreme lengths to win it back.
SpongeBob visits his old pal Bubble Buddy's hometown, Bubbletown. Sandy invites Karen and Mrs Puff out for a night on the town, so the ladies decide to blow off some steam.

Alvin invites Dave's old high school rival to an elaborate dinner to prove to him that Dave is a huge success. The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realise what they'll be leaving behind.

The Munks help a world-famous runner design a pair of prosthetic legs for a race she's set to run in. Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, and he quickly realises it won't be easy.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.
Dave sets down a very strict study schedule when Alvin blames him for his poor grades. Theodore must pose as a dog after the chipmunks accidentally shave the fur off a dog Miss Miller is watching.

When Alvin insists on taking over the drums from Theodore, Theodore fights back by stealing Alvin's persona. As Theodore is perfecting a pancake recipe, Alvin plays a trick by pouring burping powder in his next batch.

To keep a planned holiday, the boys do all they can to stop Dave from learning that Alvin has summer school; when Theodore drops a puzzle piece down a floor vent, he gets trapped inside while trying to fish it out.
Alvin books the band at a birthday party only to discover they've been booked for the petting zoo as pets; Theodore invents an imaginary friend.
Dave has a writer's block. Alvin puts a curse on Theodore.
Alvin's too short to ride a new amusement park ride; while on a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby.
After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.

When Derek overhears that Alvin and his brothers are alone for the weekend, he plans a wild party at their house. Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero, until he's told he's actually a villain.

While training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor, Theodore develops an allergy to an unknown ingredient. // After a lice outbreak that closes the school, Dave sets up a classroom in the house acting as their teacher.
Coach Dobbins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team for being slow.

When Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother, he tries to be a better role model for Alvin and Simon. Alvin tricks Theodore into believing he's great at mini golf, which backfires when Theo signs up for a tournament.

The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete in a dodgeball tournament but no-one expects Theo to be their secret weapon. The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic or something more sinister?

When Theodore discovers Alvin and Simon have a secret club, he promises not to tell anyone if they let him join. Dave promises to take Alvin to a water park if he gets a good grade on his test, but then a crow steals it.
Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting job with a spoiled four-year-old. Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life. Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet.
Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff when the Chipmunks and Chipettes head off to space camp. Theodore burns his tongue on some super-hot chocolate and loses his sense of taste.

When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.

When Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, Alvin goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend. Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

Dave gets temporary amnesia, so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead. Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a speaker at school talks to the class about the danger of germs.

Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest for his birthday and insists he wear it to an upcoming business meeting. When Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has their own ideas on how the money should be spent.

Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off at the school to Miss Smith. Convinced a zombie invasion is imminent, Alvin and Theodore go all out in an attempt to protect their loved ones.

When the Principal's cat goes missing, Theodore gives her a music box. When Dave discovers his Grandma's music box is missing, he calls the police. Theodore's been mistakenly mailed off in a box. Now Simon and Alvin have to get him home.
The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but have to keep the puppy hidden from Dave, who won't allow pets. Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.

In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells him that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into candy; when the chipmunks find a baby bird that has fallen from its nest, Alvin is reluctant to get too attached.
Dave worries that the Chipmunks have become addicted to a video game. A grounded Alvin begs Theodore to buy him a limited edition skateboard.
Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise the Chipmunks. Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating advice when they believe he has a crush on a girl.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
A disagreement between Blakey and Stan causes the lads to go on strike, which leads to major disruption, both at work and at home.

A new conductor turns out to be a conductress, Iris, whom Stan dates. Despite being middle-aged he does not want his family to know and says he is on a late shift whilst taking Iris to the pub, where Arthur sees them.
Christmas Special 1984. Penny looks back at her relationship with Vince, from their first meeting to their disastrous wedding day.
Frank Spencer is well-meaning, enthusiastic - and a one-man disaster area. His search for work leads him to become a wholesale ironmongery salesman.
Frank and Betty spend a weekend with her brother George Fisher, who is about to show off his gadget-filled 'fool-proof' home, but George soon comes to regret having them over.
Crossing the road and phoning the doctor seems straightforward enough, but not for Frank.
To make up for a disastrous first honeymoon Frank and Betty are off to the seaside, and all seems to be going well until they reach the hotel.
Frank struggles to look after himself while Betty is in the hospital. However, the fun really starts when he visits Betty.
Convinced he is a failure, a depressed Frank visits a psychiatrist, but by the time Frank has related his life story, his shrink can only agree with his analysis.
The new manager of the labour exchange refuses to believe that Frank is unemployable.

A couple of months have passed, and Gary reluctantly travels back in time again to try another investment scheme. He goes into a bank in 1941 and meets a bank manager named Mainwaring and Wilson, his chief clerk, both of whom are in the Home Guard.
Yvonne is desperate to move house and have a baby and the pressure affects Gary. He goes back to visit Phoebe and finds she has a new admirer, a Czechoslovakian soldier named Ludo.

Gary's present-day marriage is under strain. Things get worse when Gary is convicted of drink-driving and loses his driving licence and his job. In the past, Phoebe begins to warm to Gary again, and they discuss a possible future together.

Gary's fictional job with Ron may cover his trips back in time to 1941, but it's not much help when both Yvonne and Phoebe expect him for dinner on the same evening. For love to find a way, he needs more than a little bit of luck.
Yvonne is in line for promotion, and Gary suspects that he is only holding her back. Life in 1941 seems more and more appealing and Gary feels it may be time for him to make a choice.

Gary is disappointed to discover that 1941 is a great place to visit, but a terrible place to live. He's hungry and bored. Also, now that he lives in the East End, Gary is enlisted on fire-watching duty on top of a paint factory.

Gary is struggling for money, having only an imaginary job. He hits upon the idea of taking pristine 1940s items to the present and selling them. Yvonne is heavily into her drama group, much to Gary's chagrin.
Arthur is demanding police protection from a very angry customer, but since his doctor ordered him to stop smoking and drinking, Arthur's grasp of reality is brought into question.

Pauline falls spectacularly off the wagon to the dismay of Noreen and Geoff. Geoff tries to sort her out, but Pauline has drunkenly befriended young Jodie. The Solana wristbands are being replaced by a new and improved ID card system. The technicalities of the new process prove too complicated for Mateo and the staff - who end up making a hash of the whole thing. This could have dire consequences for Joyce.

Billy discovers a used pregnancy test after Mimi, Karen and Gloria spend the night boozing. He turns to Jamie for advice, and both of them set out to discover who's the daddy, with Jamie worried that the baby could be Gloria's. Jackson is suspicious because Avril and Calum are always together after hours, but when he sneers at an invitation to go clubbing, Avril leaves him behind and makes it a night to remember.
A girl tells Jo and Chrissy that she is pregnant by Robin after sleeping with her. When they confront him, he agrees to do the decent thing and to stand by his girlfriend, Linda.
Gary and Phoebe look likely to change the course of history in wartime Liverpool, where Ron's grandfather is said to have been a hero.
Terry and Arthur have a day at the beach, with Terry supposedly looking after a race horse.

Nach dem Mauerfall 1989 herrscht in der DDR Chaos. Zwischen Befreiung und Verunsicherung erleben die Bürger ein Jahr des Umbruchs. Alte Strukturen brechen weg, neue entstehen. Techno-Partys und Hausbesetzungen symbolisieren die neue Freiheit.

Frank Richter, Petra Lux, Matthias Platzeck, Katrin Göring-Eckardt und Antje Hermenau gehörten nicht zu den führenden Oppositionellen, die gegen das Regime in der DDR aufstanden. Doch die Bürgerbewegung riss auch sie in den Strom der Geschichte.

Die Alpen sind dem Klimawandel der vergangenen Jahre nicht länger gewachsen. Auch das atemberaubende Grün, das spektakuläre Farbenspiel und das Aufeinandertreffen von Sonne und Natur wird durch das Klima stark beeinflusst.

Im Himalaya leben auf den schneebedeckten Höhen einzigartige und vom Aussterben bedrohte Tiere wie der Schneeleopard. Auch die buddhistischen Klöster geben dem gewaltigen Bergmassiv eine ganz eigene Schönheit, die nicht nur Bergsteiger bestaunen.

Die Anden sind die längste Gebirgskette der Welt und bieten daher eine große Artenvielfalt. Das Massiv grenzt an die Wüste, das Meer und die Ausläufer der Antarktis. Beobachtet werden Brillenbären in den Wüsten und die seltene Salzfliegenechse.

Ein Team begibt sich auf die Mission, einem Gewitter so nah wie möglich zu kommen. Sie gefährden damit ihr Leben, da ein Blitz bereits heißer als die Oberfläche der Sonne werden kann. Das unerschrockene Team lässt sich jedoch nicht aufhalten.

Ein Teammitglied begibt sich auf einen riskanten Ritt auf einer riesigen Monsterwelle. Diese Monsterwellen können die Größe eines sechsstöckigen Gebäudes erreichen, doch lässt dies den todesmutigen Menschen nicht zurückschrecken.

Ein Team ist tapfer genug, um feuerspuckende Vulkane aus nächster Nähe anzuschauen. Dazu spielt es keine Rolle, ob es der feuerspeiende Ätna in Italien ist oder die Lavaströme des Kilauea auf Hawaii sind, um gewaltige Bilder einzufangen.

Korallenriffe, auch "Regenwald der Meere" genannt, sind für die Biodiversität in den Ozeanen kaum zu überschätzen. Doch die Existenz dieser ebenso prachtvollen wie empfindlichen Ökosysteme ist durch den Klimawandel zunehmend bedroht.
